messages:
Maya (CSM): Hey team — kicking off Integral's onboarding. Quick intro: Anya (PM) is the customer's lead, they want production inference for support triage by end of month. Goal here is to align stakeholders, owners, and a concrete 30/60/90 timeline. :raised_hands:
Anya (Integral - PM): thanks Maya! excited to get going. main priorities: SSO + data isolation for PII, lower latency for chat flows, and an internal analytics dashboard.
Liam (Solutions): noted. I'll own the integration plan for the chat flow and provide a sample SDK snippet. Can someone confirm expected request volume?
Anya (Integral - PM): starting small — ~100 reqs/min peak, mostly short sessions. we'll scale after pilot.
Esther (Product): success criteria from our POV: 1) pilot live with 95% of test prompts passing accuracy gate, 2) tail latency p95 < 300ms for 95% of days, 3) telemetry in console with token-level costs visible.
Ravi (Platform Eng): for SSO and VPC options I need the customer's network contacts + whether they require on-prem. If VPC, estimate 2w for connectivity validation.
Maya (CSM): action items: - Liam: prototype SDK webhook + example convo by Tue - Ravi: network checklist + initial security questionnaire by Wed - Esther: eval rubric + sample prompts by Thu - Anya: provide SSO contact, expected data retention, and sample dataset by Wed EOD.
Anya (Integral - PM): will share SSO contact and dataset link (private S3) today.
Liam (Solutions): drafting SDK example now. snippet for streaming response:
```
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-llama-2', input: prompt });
for await (const chunk of stream) { render(chunk.text) }
```
I'll add a sample runner repo link in the thread.
DeployBot: calendar invite sent: "Integral Onboarding - Weekly Standup" Thu 10:00 AM PT — recurrence weekly.
Maya (CSM): perfect. propose milestones: Day 0-7 config + SSO, Day 8-21 integration + pilot data, Day 22-30 pilot validation + handoff; we should lock dates after Anya shares network windows.
Esther (Product): I'll open an eval board in our console and add the initial prompt set. tagging @Liam for annotation needs.
Ravi (Platform Eng): FYI we'll want to enable KV cache for the chat flow to reduce cost — I'll include recommended config in the network checklist.
Maya (CSM): thanks all — I'll follow up with a formal kickoff doc and a short Trello board of owners. If any blockers call them out here, otherwise I'll confirm invites and deliverable owners by EOD. :white_check_mark:
